Projects and clients

; Projects and clients
;
; Group time with colons:  area:project:task
;   work:meetings        work:admin         work:learning
;   clients:acme:design  clients:acme:review
;   personal:exercise    personal:reading
;
; Use the same account to clock in and out. A description can follow the
; account after two spaces:
;   i {{year}}-03-14 14:00:00 clients:acme:design  landing page mockups
;
; Start the clock with Sessions → Clock in, or type the lines below.

Project tracker

; Project tracker
;
; Copy a line under a date and add the time after two or more spaces.
;
;   work:project-a
;   work:project-b
;   work:meetings
;   work:admin
;   work:learning
;   personal:exercise
;   personal:reading
;   personal:errands
;
; Start a day with a date, for example:
;   {{year}}-03-14
;   work:project-a  .... ....
